candidates.description: This feature vector represents the letter 'h' and words or subwords starting with or heavily featuring the letter 'h'.
This vector represents South Asian, particularly Indian and Nepali, personal names and geographic terms.
This vector activates for non-ASCII characters, diacritics, and accented letters common in European languages.
This vector represents combinations of closing quotation marks, parentheses, and terminal punctuation marks typically found at the ends of quoted sentences or parenthetical statements.
The feature vector represents tokens containing the letter sequence "ut".
This vector activates on prefixes, roots, and fragments associated with the Latin-derived adjective "perfect" and related words sharing similar orthographic structures.
These tokens represent Roman numerals used for numbering, sequencing, or outlining.
This feature vector represents the concept of plurality, diversity, and varied quantity in Spanish.
This vector is related to word-initial or prominent syllables featuring the sounds /m/ and /a/.
This vector activates on words and subwords containing the letters "y" or "Y" in various morphological contexts.
